title: fix(hook): a seat report reaches the planner once outside auto mode
why: taoq-ai/wuwei#1198: on 2026-10-20 in bypass mode every seat report reached the planner 2 to 6 times (task notification, PreToolUse context, Stop block), doubling planner context per seat. Owner ruled standard tier for today's batch.
promise: Outside auto mode the hook delivers each kept seat report (.wuwei/reports/<file>) at most once: it records the report ids it has delivered and never repeats one in a PreToolUse note or a Stop block; the Stop hook names only reports not yet delivered and does not block on report text it already gave. Auto mode is unchanged. Files: cli/wuwei/hook.py and the vendored copy, tests/test_hook.py, docs/site/concepts/hooks.md. AGENTS.md Testing the guards applies to hook.py: route corpus at main and head with sha256. Runtime budget: 4 lines.
acceptance: Given two seats stopped outside auto mode, when the planner's next PreToolUse and Stop run, then each report appears once across them
Given a report already delivered, when a later Stop runs, then it is not listed and the Stop does not block on it
Given auto mode, when a seat hands back, then nothing changes from main

title: fix(evidence): a review thread counts as unanswered only when its last comment is not the owner's
why: taoq-ai/wuwei#1199: ai-assemble#2141 showed 10 unanswered threads that all ended with the owner's reply; owes R-1 and R-2 stayed overdue all day and the Stop hook kept listing them.
promise: `N review threads unanswered` counts threads that are unresolved and whose last comment is not by the owner (the PR's owner login WUWEI already reads); an unresolved thread the owner answered no longer counts and no longer holds a merge; an owe whose where is that thread closes when its last comment is the owner's. Files: cli/wuwei/gh.py and/or evidence.py and board.py with vendored copies, tests. A change to the gaps in evidence.py runs the route differential. Runtime budget: 3 lines.
acceptance: Given an unresolved thread whose last comment is the owner's, when evidence is read, then it is not counted as unanswered
Given an unresolved thread whose last comment is a reviewer's, when evidence is read, then it is counted
Given an owe on a thread the owner last replied in, when the board is read, then the owe closes

title: fix(board): a run item is not marked done when a PR naming it merges
why: taoq-ai/wuwei#1200: G7-V4-HEAD-FIRST read done after its runner PR merged while production still had head none; later items keyed on it looked unblocked.
promise: board marks an item done on a merged PR only when the item is not kind run; for a run item a merged PR records run evidence (`code merged as <ref>, run owed`) and the item stays open until `wuwei plan done <id> --reason <run evidence>`. Files: cli/wuwei/board.py and the vendored copy, tests/test_watch.py or the board tests. Runtime budget: 2 lines.
acceptance: Given a run item and a merged PR naming it, when the board is read, then the item stays open and shows code merged, run owed
Given a build item and a merged PR naming it, when the board is read, then it is marked done as on main
Given that run item, when the planner runs wuwei plan done with run evidence, then it is done

title: feat(board): a registered Codex job shows running, completed, failed or asked a question
why: taoq-ai/wuwei#1201: nine Codex jobs ran on 2026-10-20; their end, failure or a design question reached the planner only by tailing logs, and run rows stayed [waiting].
promise: `wuwei plan run <id> --job <path to the companion's job JSON>` records the job file on the item; the board reads only files registered this way (never scans another plugin's folders) and shows the job's state from it: running, completed, failed, or asked a question (the job ended its turn with a question), with the HANDOFF.md path when the job names one. An unreadable or missing job file reads `job state unreadable`, never done. Files: cli/wuwei/__main__.py, plan.py, board.py and vendored copies, tests, charters/planner.md and docs. Runtime budget: 6 lines; if the companion's job JSON shape cannot be read from a real job file on this machine, record the shape assumed under Assumptions.
acceptance: Given a run item registered with a running job file, when the board is read, then it shows the job running
Given the job file reports completed with a HANDOFF path, when the board is read, then it shows completed and the path
Given a failed or question-ending job, when the board is read, then it shows failed or asked a question
Given a missing job file, when the board is read, then it shows job state unreadable

title: fix(board): an item that names a PR without its plan link says so, and plan add links a taken-over PR
why: taoq-ai/wuwei#1202: six taken-over PRs by another author sat unlinked for three days and their items read no pull request yet. Part 2 (planner doing shepherd work) is mostly covered by #1189's orchestration row on main.
promise: When an open item with no linked PR names a PR (`owner/repo#n` or `#n` of its repo in its title, promise or run reason) that is open, the board shows `PR owner/repo#n not linked: add the WUWEI footer naming <id>` in place of `no pull request yet`; `wuwei plan add --pr owner/repo#n` records the PR on the item and the board links it without a body line. Part 2: record under Assumptions that #1189's orchestration line covers the no-shepherd case; add no new note unless it fits the budget. Files: cli/wuwei/board.py, plan.py, __main__.py and vendored copies, tests, docs/site/reference.md. Runtime budget: 8 lines.
acceptance: Given an item whose title names open PR acme/app#7 with no plan link, when the board is read, then it says PR acme/app#7 not linked
Given wuwei plan add with --pr acme/app#7, when the board is read, then the item links #7 and reads its gaps
Given an item naming a merged or closed PR, when the board is read, then the not-linked line does not show
